subject: Order form kickoff — signer roles, template fit, and redline priorities
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@avasoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form kickoff — signer roles, template fit, and redline priorities

Hi Samir —

Thanks for moving this to the contracting lane. Attaching our draft order form and a small CSV that maps the signer roles we typically expect (billing, legal, executive). Can you confirm the following so we can prioritize the intake properly?

- Who will be the commercial signer (name/title/email) and is that person the same as the billing contact?
- Do you have a preferred Redwood template variant (Standard / Enterprise / Regulated) or should we propose one based on seat count and hosting?
- Any mandatory PO number or procurement terms we need to accept up front?
- Target turn-around for your redlines (we typically ask for 3 business days for initial comments).

Proposed next step: 30-minute call to align on signers and template choice — Jonas Weber from our contracting ops can join. Available windows tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PT or 15:00–16:00 PT.

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_draft_v1.docx; ExhibitA_Signer_Roles.csv

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@avasoft.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: AvaSoft Procurement <procurement@avasoft.com>, Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@avasoft.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form kickoff — signer roles, template fit, and redline priorities

Rachel —

Appreciate the quick start. Quick answers below:

- Commercial signer: Jamie Liao, VP Finance (jamie.liao@avasoft.com). Billing contacts are separate (procurement@avasoft.com).
- Template: We usually run on your Standard template unless there are specific residency/SLA addenda (we will flag if so).
- PO: We always issue POs; provisional PO number will arrive once we have the negotiated payment terms (we try to attach PO within the first week).
- Timeline: 3 business days for initial redlines works for us.

I attached a short procurement checklist our team uses (not a formal doc, just pointers).

Can do the 10:00 PT slot tomorrow — please send calendar invite.

Team — forwarding Samir's replies. Action items below so we move cleanly once redlines arrive:

- Marissa: please triage any commercial / SLA asks in the redline doc; prioritize uptime/SLO language and termination triggers.
- Kimberly: confirm billing/PO acceptance path and whether we need pre-signed billing addendum; draft a quick note on acceptable PO language.
- Jonas: I'll let you handle scheduling and join the 10:00 PT call tomorrow to confirm template variant and signer mapping.
- Jordan: please prepare a short fallback plan if they request specific residency or data segregation clauses (we've had a couple of these lately).

I'll send the calendar invite for 10:00 PT and include Samir & Jamie. Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_draft_v1.docx; ExhibitA_Signer_Roles.csv

Thanks — Rachel

- Request to swap our standard PO flow into Section 4 (billing) and a note that net-45 is preferred.
- A couple of liability threshold asks around data residency — they left those as comments for Redwood to propose language.
- Requested a small SLA addendum to be reviewed by Marissa.

We aim to have a signable version within two rounds of edits. Rachel — thanks for the call earlier, that helped align.
